tagline: Finds database records that cannot be true as written, quotes the source document showing which field is wrong, and leaves the fix to a person. It never edits a record.
track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why

data.source: NCI Genomic Data Commons, TCGA-BRCA (1,097 cases): clinical fields and pathology report text

models_shipped.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b: first read, thinking off, through Meterless Nightshift; may only close a field that agrees with the registry; also 'Ask the layer': tool calls over read-only Zetaris tools (docs/evidence/ask-layer-v2-results.md)
models_shipped.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b: deep read at a 4k thinking budget, case notes and the red team, through Nightshift; page-image reads NVIDIA direct
models_shipped.nvidia/nemotron-parse: v1, boxes the evidence line on scanned reports (NVIDIA direct: Nightshift has no Parse lane)
models_shipped.nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b: second reader that may only object, through Nightshift; an objection sends the case to a person

nvidia.local: the first read also runs on the builder's PC through Nightshift's Jobs API with local-only privacy, on whole reports since the 2026-10-26 Nightshift release (python -m app.cli run --case <id> --local; docs/evidence/local-whole-results.md)
nvidia.which_model_handled_the_request: every Nightshift receipt names the winning model and is checked against the requested one; the case page and /how show the model per step; docs/evidence/route-ledger.md

meterless.nightshift: 1.2.3, re-verified on the 2026-10-26 release; the primary AI provider: pinned model, unique scope per call, Ed25519 receipt verified against a pinned key, cache refused (app/providers/nightshift.py, app/providers/receipts.py)
meterless.engine: Markovian reference, vendored unmodified (conformance 8 of 8): the per-record evidence chain and a red-team loop (vendor/, app/engine/markovian.py)

zetaris.usl: stage_audit (8 tables over the NCI GDC REST API, a file store and an append-only Postgres; the cross-field rule, the verdict column and the three answers are SQL in the layer) and attest_audit (signed receipts and re-read results, 5 DQ rules)

sponsor_technology.cursor: a build tool, not a sponsor: the first commits were written by Cursor's agent; later code by Claude Code; Grok in Cursor (Ask mode, repo open) did read-only critical and red-team reviews (see README, How this was built)

run.sample_mode: python -m app.cli serve  (no keys, no network; open http://127.0.0.1:8000)

ai_usage: Built with AI coding tools (Cursor's agent, then Claude Code); see README, How this was built
pre_existing_components: Research and planning notes from before 22 Oct, kept outside the repository (no code)

Spike results reused and stated where they appear: the 42-report spike set with its truth labels and the 'unlimited' thinking arm (run 21 Oct); the off, 1k and 4k arms of the same table ran 22 Oct 10:19-11:35 UTC in that spike, outside the repository (docs/evidence/thinking-budget.md); the held-out flagging result (docs/evidence/heldout-flagging.md); a Nemotron Parse 2.0 probe on 19 Oct and Nightshift image calls on 21 Oct (docs/evidence/scan-boxes.md, docs/evidence/nightshift-limits.md); a 26-line Python fetch used as a size comparison (docs/details.md)
Vendored, unmodified: the Meterless Markovian reference engine (vendor/meterless-markovian, Apache-2.0, NOTICE)
Public data: NCI GDC TCGA clinical data and pathology reports; FEC and IRS public files
The repository's first commit is after 22 Oct 00:00 UTC
